items.markdown:
Car window tinting in Adelaide starts at **$120** for front-door only matches and ranges from **$250 to $700+** for a full vehicle , depending on the car size and film type. Standard carbon films (UV blocking/glare reduction) are cheaper, while high-performance ceramic films cost more.[](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices-guide/) [[1]](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices-guide/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/affordablewindowtintingadl/)[[3]](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices-start-at/)[[4]](https://mastertint.com.au/ceramic-vs-carbon-window-tint-which-wins/)[[5]](https://www.ultrashadetint.com.au/automotive-window-tint-gold-coast/)

The price varies depending on the type of film and your vehicle:

**Average Adelaide Prices by Vehicle Size** 

- **Front Windows Only:** $120 – $250
- **Hatchbacks & Single Cab Utes:** $250 – $350
- **Sedans:** $250 – $450
- **SUVs, Wagons & 4WDs:** $300 – $700[](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices-guide/) [[1]](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices/)[[2]](https://kdautodetailingadelaide.com.au/window-tinting-adelaide/)

**Price Varies by Film Type** 

- **Basic / Dyed / Carbon Film:** Standard protection and heat rejection. Great for standard privacy and style.
- **Ceramic / Nano-Ceramic Film:** Maximum heat and IR rejection, ensuring a cooler cabin without signal interference. These typically cost an additional **$150 – $300** on top of base prices.[](https://r1auto.com.au/adelaide/car-window-tinting-adelaide-prices-start-at/) [[1]](https://mrcleanadelaide.com.au/window-tint-deals-adelaide/)[[2]](https://llumarfilms.com.au/automotive-window-film/)[[3]](https://r1auto.com.au/blog/cost-to-tint-car-windows/)

**Additional Local Costs to Factor In** 

- **Old Tint Removal:** Expect to pay roughly **$60** if you have bubbling or peeling factory/dealer tint that needs stripping.
- **Mobile Services:** Some installers charge a small call-out fee or offer drop-off packages (e.g., at St Clair or Gilles Plains).[](https://affordablewindowtintingadl.setmore.com/) [[1]](https://affordablewindowtintingadl.setmore.com/)[[2]](https://r1auto.com.au/newcastle/is-mobile-window-tinting-worth-it-for-car/)
